class.name: NNBTSpatialActionLeaf
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree leaves that act on a target in 2D or 3D space.
class.description: Holds the target configuration shared by [NNBTMoveTo2D], [NNBTMoveTo3D], [NNBTLookAt2D] and [NNBTLookAt3D]. Each 2D or 3D subclass adds a [code]target_position[/code] property of its own vector type. The target is read again on every tick, so a moving node or a changing blackboard value is followed. A target that is gone at runtime, such as a freed [member target_node], a freed node stored under [member target_key] or a missing blackboard value, makes the leaf return [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] without an error. A misconfigured target, such as [constant TARGET_NODE] with no [member target_node], [constant TARGET_BLACKBOARD] with an empty [member target_key], or a node or value of the wrong type, reports an error once per node instance and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. This class cannot be instantiated.

members.member: The blackboard key read when [member target_source] is [constant TARGET_BLACKBOARD]. The value may be a [Node2D] or [Vector2] for a 2D leaf, or a [Node3D] or [Vector3] for a 3D leaf.
The node whose global position is the target when [member target_source] is [constant TARGET_NODE]. Must be a [Node2D] for a 2D leaf or a [Node3D] for a 3D leaf.
Where the target comes from. The inspector shows only the property the chosen source uses.

constants.constant: The target is the subclass's [code]target_position[/code], in global coordinates.
The target is the global position of [member target_node].
The target is the node or vector stored under [member target_key] in the effective blackboard.
